Check the 24V according to the picture:
Replace the broken items; I will provide the reference numbers:
8EM5905-0AA00-8A - Controlpanel Adaptation Set
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA0 -PH10 Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/ AC cutout
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8 -PH11 Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR

unified service process
